name: China Animal Husbandry Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: China Animal Husbandry Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in research, development, production, sales, and technical services of animal health and nutrition products in China and internationally. It operates through four segments: Animal Disease Epidemic Prevention; Animal disease treatment; Animal Nutrition; and Others.
